articles.title: Gurgaon bank employee raped by live-in 'married' partner, forced into 3 abortions; Rs 35 lakh swindled
articles.description: A private bank employee from Bhiwani has alleged that her colleague raped her under the guise of marriage. Over the course of their relationship, she was forced to have three abortions after becoming pregnant. The accused allegedly swindled her out of Rs 35 lakh and threatened to expose her private pictures. After marrying another man, she was compelled to return to the accused due to these threats.

articles.title: Hyundai, Samsung eye India's shipbuilding push as Centre lines up Rs 69,725-crore package
articles.description: India's shipbuilding industry is attracting global partnerships, particularly with Hyundai and Samsung on significant projects. The government targets a seafaring workforce of around 600,000 by 2030, up from 320,000 currently. Proposed investments for new shipyards in Thoothukudi and Pipavav aim to boost domestic shipbuilding capacity. Collaborations and government incentives are expected to enhance India's position in global maritime trade.

articles.title: GTA 6 fever creates a business opportunity for gaming cafes, homestays and console owners
articles.description: GTA 6's release has been a significant pop-cultural event, leading to immense social media engagement. Many gamers are unable to buy consoles because of their high costs, impacting their ability to play the game. Numerous individuals are finding creative ways to access consoles, including traveling or renting. Gaming cafes are seeing increased demand and higher prices following the launch.

articles.title: India's shift to SUVs drives demand for bigger parking bays, stronger systems
articles.description: India's increasing preference for SUVs is transforming parking solutions and infrastructure to accommodate larger vehicles. Parking companies must now design systems capable of managing newly required dimensions and weight. Real estate developers are adjusting their plans to offer flexible parking layouts while maximizing available space. Meanwhile, automakers are responding to demand for advanced parking-assistance technologies to aid urban drivers.
